:::{#exr-normal-vector-practice}
#### Finding a normal vector of a plane in $\reals^3$

In $\reals^3$ a [hyperplane](#def-hyperplane) is a plane,
and a [normal vector](#def-normal-vector) points straight out of it.
Let $H$ be the hyperplane of points $\vx \in \reals^3$ with

$$
2 x_1 - x_2 + 4 x_3 = 7.
$$

Find a [normal vector of $H$](#def-normal-vector).

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Rewrite the equation in the form of @def-hyperplane.

:::
